annotator: independent Claude agent (blind to system outputs)
guidelines: Each JD was read in full and only technical skills explicitly written in it (or a taxonomy alias of one) that are asked of the candidate or named as the stack the intern will use were labeled, mapped to canonical taxonomy keys; nothing was inferred, and soft skills, degrees/majors and company product descriptions were excluded. Skills were split into required (minimum/basic or plainly required, or everything when the JD has no split) and nice_to_have (preferred/bonus/plus), each skill listed once at its highest tier. Technical skills with no taxonomy entry go in other (unscored); genuinely ambiguous cases were left out and explained in notes.
